LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking Phonological awareness Sound discrimination, initials and
Topic 1.2: Phonological Awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Phonological Awareness. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is correct articulation of words important in communication?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. compose simple sentences on various themes

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. compose simple sentences on various themes
   In simple words: practise until you can compose simple sentences on various themes. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Phonological Awareness using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Phonological Awareness in the examples.
2. Explain Phonological Awareness to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Phonological Awareness.
4. Show that you can: compose simple sentences on various themes

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Phonological Awareness using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Phonological Awareness important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Listen and repeat saying initials and finals from a recording (z, c, s, zh, ch, sh, r, w, y,ai ,ei, ui ,ou ,iu, ie, ü ,un, an, en, ang, eng, ing, ong),
2. Listen to an introduction of a friend and respond to the questions (我朋 友叫什么名字? 他是不是女孩、 男孩?),
3. Listen to an audio clip with simple sentences on Chinese pronouns and select the correct one to fill in the gaps ( 您、你、我、她、他),
4. The learner links their learning to English and Kiswahili on the use of appropriate pronouns in varied contexts.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. compose simple sentences on various themes

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
